source_identification: UNL Mathematics Qualifying Exam 852/871, June 2007. Section A contains five graph-theory/combinatorics problems; Section B contains four topology problems. The instructions ask for three problems from each section.
card_reconciliation: The existing complete SRC-UNL-QUAL-852-871-JUNE-2007 collection represents all nine source positions in order. Section A uses five source-local cards; Section B is verbatim the first four questions of SRC-TOP-UNL-2007Q2 and reuses canonical cards P-T07A1 through P-T07A4.
